source_basis: Magic items use SRD 5.2.1 names and mechanics, paraphrased for the Killer In The Keep runtime. Mundane gear uses SRD-compatible fifth-edition terminology.
draw_sources: Chests after trap and lock resolution
Bookshelves and display cases after Search resolution
Room objectives and authored fixed placements
high_magic_adjustment: Hosts may increase Rare and Very Rare weight. Legendary treasure requires an authored final-act reward.
attunement_rule: A living character can be attuned to no more than three items. The video-game runtime must clearly show attunement slots and prevent a fourth active attunement.
fixed_map_reference_rule: When a map placement lists a specific treasure card ID, that fixed card overrides a random draw. Container card IDs define the chest wrapper and number of item draws.
death_return_rule: On permanent death, deck-owned unconsumed Treasure cards return to this deck and are shuffled before the new ghost state begins.

container_cards.name: Large Iron Chest
container_cards.magic_item_chance: 1 guaranteed magic draw in Standard mode

container_cards.name: Trapped Large Wooden Chest
container_cards.magic_item_chance: 1 guaranteed magic draw after safe resolution

container_cards.name: Trapped Small Ornate Chest
container_cards.magic_item_chance: At least Uncommon if trap is disarmed

cards.name: Potion of Healing
cards.effect: Drink or administer as a Bonus Action to restore 2d4 + 2 HP.

cards.name: Potion of Healing (Greater)
cards.effect: Drink or administer as a Bonus Action to restore 4d4 + 4 HP.

cards.name: Potion of Heroism
cards.effect: Gain 10 Temporary HP and the benefit of Bless for 1 hour without Concentration.

cards.name: Potion of Invisibility
cards.effect: Become Invisible for 1 hour; the effect ends after attacking, dealing damage, or casting a spell.

cards.name: Potion of Resistance
cards.effect: Gain Resistance to one rolled damage type for 1 hour.

cards.name: Potion of Climbing
cards.effect: For 1 hour, gain a Climb Speed equal to Speed and Advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks to climb.

cards.name: Potion of Speed
cards.effect: Gain the Haste spell effect for 1 minute without Concentration and without the ending lethargy.
cards.availability: High Magic or boss chest only.

cards.name: Elixir of Health
cards.effect: End magical contagions and the Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, and Poisoned conditions on the drinker.

cards.name: Bag of Holding
cards.effect: Holds up to 500 pounds or 64 cubic feet while weighing 5 pounds. Retrieving an item uses a Utilize action.
cards.game_rule: It can store ordinary Treasure and usable gear, but cannot hide evidence cards or erase the incompatible-weapon hoarding penalty unless the weapon is explicitly stowed during a legal inventory action.

cards.name: Boots of Elvenkind
cards.effect: Your steps make no sound and you have Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.

cards.name: Boots of Speed
cards.effect: Use a Bonus Action to double Speed and impose Disadvantage on Opportunity Attacks against you for up to 10 total minutes per Long Rest.

cards.name: Boots of Striding and Springing
cards.effect: Speed becomes at least 30 feet, excess carried weight and Heavy Armor do not reduce it, and once per turn you can jump up to 30 feet by spending 10 feet of movement.

cards.name: Cloak of Protection
cards.effect: Gain +1 AC and +1 to saving throws while worn.

cards.name: Gloves of Thievery
cards.effect: The gloves are imperceptible while worn and grant +5 to Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) checks.
cards.game_rule: They do not automatically disarm traps; trap disarming still uses the game’s Dexterity + Thieves’ Tools procedure.

cards.name: Goggles of Night
cards.effect: Gain Darkvision to 60 feet, or extend existing Darkvision by 60 feet.

cards.name: Immovable Rod
cards.effect: Activate or release the rod with a Utilize action. While fixed, it remains in place and can support up to 8,000 pounds; extraordinary force can move it.
cards.game_rule: May brace a door, anchor a rope, hold a pressure plate, or create an alternate trap counterplay when geometry permits.

cards.name: Lantern of Revealing
cards.effect: While lit, Invisible creatures and objects are visible inside its 30-foot Bright Light.

cards.name: Periapt of Wound Closure
cards.effect: A Death Save of 9 or lower can become a 10, and Hit Point Dice restore double HP.
cards.game_rule: Free For All death-save rules remain active; this item improves survival rather than removing the downed state.

cards.name: Ring of Protection
cards.effect: Gain +1 AC and +1 to saving throws while worn.

cards.name: Ring of Feather Falling
cards.effect: While falling, descend 60 feet per round and take no falling damage.

cards.name: Rope of Climbing
cards.effect: A 60-foot rope that can animate toward a destination, fasten itself, and support up to 3,000 pounds.
cards.game_rule: Can create a legal vertical route only where the map exposes climbable geometry.

cards.name: Stone of Good Luck (Luckstone)
cards.effect: Gain +1 to ability checks and saving throws while the stone is on your person.

cards.name: Wand of Magic Detection
cards.effect: Has 3 charges; expend 1 to cast Detect Magic. Regains 1d3 charges at dawn.

cards.name: Wand of Secrets
cards.effect: Has 3 charges; expend 1 as a Magic action to point toward the nearest secret door or trap within 60 feet. Regains 1d3 charges at dawn.
cards.game_rule: It reveals direction, not an automatic safe route or disable result.

cards.name: Wand of Magic Missiles
cards.effect: Has 7 charges; expend up to 3 charges to cast Magic Missile at the corresponding spell level. Regains 1d6 + 1 charges at dawn; using the last charge risks destruction.

cards.name: Chime of Opening
cards.effect: Can cast Knock up to 10 times, but its ringing is audible out to 300 feet. It breaks after the tenth use.
cards.game_rule: Opening a trapped entry does not disarm its trap; the loud tone may trigger nearby monsters.

cards.name: Gem of Seeing
cards.effect: Has 3 charges; expend 1 for 10 minutes of Truesight to 120 feet while looking through the gem. Regains 1d3 charges at dawn.

cards.name: Bracers of Defense
cards.effect: Gain +2 AC while wearing no armor and using no Shield.

cards.name: Oil of Slipperiness
cards.effect: Apply to a creature for Freedom of Movement for 8 hours, or pour it over a 10-foot square to create a Grease effect for 8 hours.

cards.name: Silver Pearl
cards.effect: Counts toward recovered treasure value and can be traded.

cards.name: Lockpicks
cards.effect: A compact thieves’ tool component set. Enables lock and trap attempts when the character lacks another valid kit; proficiency is tracked separately.

cards.name: Crowbar
cards.effect: Grants Advantage on applicable Strength checks where leverage helps; noisy use can trigger encounters.

cards.name: Healer’s Kit
cards.effect: Spend a use to stabilize a creature at 0 HP without an ability check.

cards.name: Antitoxin
cards.effect: Grants Advantage for 1 hour on saving throws made to avoid or end the Poisoned condition.

cards.name: Holy Water
cards.effect: Can damage Fiends and Undead according to the game’s SRD equipment action.

cards.name: Rope and Grappling Hook
cards.effect: Supports climbing, anchoring, rescue, and environmental trap counterplay where geometry permits.

cards.name: Old Keep Coin Purse
cards.effect: Roll the configured coin table and add the result to recovered treasure value.
